title: Turkey police detain dozens over pro-LGBTQ Istanbul rally

blocks.text: ISTANBUL, Turkey — Turkish police on Tuesday detained dozens protesting against a nationwide LGBTQ crackdown that the government says is intended to protect traditional family values, AFP journalists at the scene reported.
